Great place for someone who is finding for authentic local food in Ha Noi.
Jun 2023 • Friends
Nhat An Nam - Street Food in Hanoi is a delightful spot for Vietnamese and Asian cuisine. With vegan options available, it caters to diverse dietary preferences. The street food-style dishes offer authentic flavors that are both satisfying and enjoyable. The casual ambiance adds to the overall dining experience. For a taste of Vietnam and Asia's vibrant street food culture, Nhat An Nam is a must-try in Hanoi.
